answer: New identities start in a slow lane: each agent posts a refundable stake into a shared vault that only unlocks after verified useful work, so creating a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes. Endorsements form a trellis: each vouch links the voucher own stake to the newcomer, and if the newcomer cheats, the voucher stake is slashed too. No stake, no haven: unvouched agents can read but cannot transact, so a sybil swarm finds no shelter and no profit, while honest newcomers earn trust gradually.
